scope: D33: longer IPC frame budgets, a process-start-time identity cache, and throttled lost-frame logging

libraries.verified: 2026-11-07 D33: Process.StartTime is a DateTime giving when the associated process started, so PID plus its converted UTC start time distinguishes PID reuse; Context7 did not index this symbol, confirmed in Microsoft Learn (query: "System.Diagnostics.Process.StartTime property in .NET 10: DateTime value start time of associated process, remains fixed for process lifetime, can distinguish reused process IDs; GetProcessById and StartTime.ToUniversalTime use.").

2026-11-07 D33: Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.LoggerExtensions.Log accepts a LogLevel variable and overloads for the formatted message and for an exception plus message, confirmed in Context7 and Microsoft Learn (query: "Microsoft.Extensions.Logging ILogger.Log(LogLevel logLevel, Exception? exception, string? message, params object?[] args) and ILogger.Log(LogLevel logLevel, string? message, params object?[] args) when level is a variable: .NET 10 extension method dynamic severity vs LogDebug and LogWarning.").
